note: Fake workspace; records the API calls the real SidebarManager makes

traces.label: redraw: one deferred (not yet loaded) review view is skipped
init registers the view type; the factory reads the handler from the plugin at creation time
activate at startup, setting on, no review leaf: takes the right sidebar leaf and sets the view state (does not reveal)
activate at startup, setting on, a review leaf exists: sets the state again on that leaf
activate at startup, setting off: nothing
activate when getRightLeaf(false) returns an already occupied leaf (not what obsidian.d.ts documents; a what-if): the code does not check, it sets the state on whatever leaf it got
activate, no leaf can be made
open command, no review leaf: fresh sidebar leaf gets the view, then is revealed
open command, review leaf exists: revealed only
open command, review leaf exists but not loaded yet (deferred, view type already the review type): revealed only
open command when getRightLeaf(false) returns an already occupied leaf (what-if, see above): its view type differs so the state is set on it, then it is revealed
